note: Triennial election of Londonderry Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. Waterside, Ardmore and Claudy were contested and the Unionists held all three against Independents; nine other divisions were filled unopposed at nomination on 19 May 1964 (Londonderry Sentinel, 20 May 1964, p. 1). The Dungiven and Faughanvale contests reported in the same articles were for Londonderry County Council. Glendermott added from the first meeting of the new council (meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). No Glendermott nomination appears in either 1964 nomination list (Londonderry Sentinel, 20 May 1964, p. 1; Derry Journal, 22 May 1964), and no Glendermott contest or result was reported; as in 1952, when Glendermott had no nomination, the outgoing member continued. Division inferred from the 1 June 1961 return (John James Snodgrass, elected for Glendermott, Belfast News-Letter, 2 June 1961, p. 9); the Londonderry Sentinel (17 June 1964, p. 34) names him at the first meeting of the new council, which co-opted three members (McLaughlin, Lamberton, McCorkell), none for Glendermott. He is styled 'Mr. J. S. Snodgrass, J.P., Glendermott' in May 1967. Returned unopposed.
